Ravi P: Syncing briefly on the NovaEdge perf/W micro-sweep. Goal: tight perf/W (steady-state) numbers for single-board runs and a short kernel-tune iteration. Main asks: driver+firmware bundle, power sampling cadence, and a reproducible command line.

Elena (NovaEdge): We can provide drivers v3.4.0 + microcode v6. Bundle URL: https://files.novaedge.example/releases/3.4.0.tar.gz. Recommend 10Hz steady-state sampling, 25Hz during tuning. We'll include nvx-instrument.sh for counters.

Zoe L: For infra use redwood/infer:prod-2026-04-2, kernel 5.19.22, cpufreq=performance. Run template:
```bash
./run_perf.sh --model gpt-3-small-q4 --seq 1024 --batch 4 --duration 600 --power-sample 10 --out s3://redwood-partnerships/novaedge/1767001123/
```
We will produce a JSON manifest per run.

Ravi P: Matrix: baseline kernel vs tuned kernel (single pass), q4 only for this sweep, cold vs warm KV cache. Each run 4x. Metrics: avg power, tokens/sec, perf/W, p95 latency.

Elena (NovaEdge): We'll ship a tiny kernel patch (L2 tweak) and an annotated runbook by Tue EOD.

OpsBot: lab-slot reserved 2026-04-20 09:00-13:00 UTC (1 board) :white_check_mark:

Ravi P: Owners: Zoe runs & uploads artifacts, Elena delivers drivers & runbook, I validate numbers and draft the methods blurb. We'll reconvene after the first run for figures. Thanks.
